claim.en: Good children always hug and kiss elders when they are told to.
claim.hg: Acche bachche bolne par badon ko hamesha hug aur pappi dete hain.

fact.en: Being polite does not mean giving up your body. You can greet elders with a namaste, a smile, or by touching their feet if that is your family's custom and you are comfortable. A hug or a kiss should happen only when you want it. Learning this early helps children speak up if a touch ever feels wrong.
fact.hg: Polite hone ka matlab apni body par se apna haq chhodna nahi hai. Tum badon ko namaste karke, smile karke, ya pair chhookar mil sakte ho, agar tumhare ghar mein yeh custom hai aur tum comfortable ho. Hug ya pappi tabhi ho jab tumhara mann ho. Yeh baat jaldi seekh lene se bachche tab bol paate hain jab koi touch galat lage.

why.en: Many families see hugging elders as a sign of respect and love, and adults may feel hurt or embarrassed when a child refuses in front of guests.
why.hg: Bahut si families mein badon ko hug karna respect aur pyaar ki nishani maana jaata hai, aur jab bachcha guests ke saamne mana karta hai toh badon ko bura ya embarrassing lag sakta hai.

claim.en: Even if someone says 'don't tell anyone', you should tell a trusted grown-up when a secret feels bad.
claim.hg: Chahe koi bole 'kisi ko mat batana', agar secret bura lage toh kisi trusted bade ko bata dena chahiye.

fact.en: True. Happy secrets, like a surprise party, are fine because they end soon and nobody gets hurt. A secret that makes you scared, sad or confused, or one about touching, photos or gifts, should always be told to a trusted adult. Telling is not breaking a promise. It is keeping yourself safe.
fact.hg: Sahi hai. Happy secrets, jaise surprise party, theek hain kyunki woh jaldi khatam ho jaate hain aur kisi ko hurt nahi hota. Jo secret tumhe daraye, udaas kare ya confuse kare, ya jo touch, photos ya gifts ke baare mein ho, woh hamesha kisi trusted adult ko batana chahiye. Batana promise todna nahi hai. Yeh khud ko safe rakhna hai.

why.en: Children are taught that keeping promises is good and telling tales is bad, so breaking a secret can feel like doing something wrong.
why.hg: Bachchon ko sikhaya jaata hai ki promise nibhana acchi baat hai aur chugli karna buri, isliye secret kholna kuch galat karne jaisa lag sakta hai.

claim.en: If you say no to a friend, you are a bad friend.
claim.hg: Agar tum dost ko 'no' bolte ho, toh tum bure dost ho.

fact.en: Saying no to something you do not want, such as sharing your password, copying homework, a dare or a hug, does not make you a bad friend. Respectful friends accept a no without teasing you or dropping you. A friend who stays only when you always agree is using pressure, and real friendships survive disagreement.
fact.hg: Jo cheez tumhe nahi chahiye, jaise password share karna, homework copy karana, koi dare ya hug, uske liye 'no' bolne se tum bure dost nahi ban jaate. Respect karne wale dost 'no' ko accept kar lete hain, na chidhate hain, na dosti todte hain. Jo dost tabhi saath rahe jab tum har baat mein haan bolo, woh pressure daal raha hai, aur real dosti disagreement ke baad bhi tiki rehti hai.

why.en: At this age fitting in feels very important, and many of us are praised for being 'adjusting', so refusing can feel selfish or risky.
why.hg: Is age mein group mein fit hona bahut important lagta hai, aur hum mein se kaiyon ki tareef 'adjust' karne par hoti hai, isliye mana karna selfish ya risky lag sakta hai.

claim.en: If they didn't say no, it's a yes.
claim.hg: Agar usne 'no' nahi bola, toh matlab 'yes' hai.

fact.en: Consent means a clear, willing yes. Silence, freezing, staying still, or being asleep, unconscious or heavily intoxicated are not consent. Fear and shock commonly leave people unable to speak or resist. The person who wants to go ahead is responsible for checking, and an unclear answer means stop.
fact.hg: Consent ka matlab hai clear aur mann se boli gayi 'yes'. Chup rehna, freeze ho jaana, bina hile pade rehna, ya soya hua, behosh ya bahut zyada nashe mein hona consent nahi hai. Darr aur shock mein log aksar na bol paate hain, na resist kar paate hain. Jo aage badhna chahta hai, check karne ki zimmedari usi ki hai, aur jawab clear na ho toh matlab hai ruk jaana.

why.en: Films and songs often show persistence 'winning' someone over, and many people were never taught that agreement has to be actively given.
why.hg: Films aur gaano mein aksar dikhaya jaata hai ki peeche pade rehne se saamne wala 'maan' jaata hai, aur bahut logon ko kabhi sikhaya hi nahi gaya ki agreement actively diya jaana chahiye.

claim.en: Once you've said yes, you can't change your mind.
claim.hg: Ek baar 'yes' bol diya, toh phir mann nahi badal sakte.

fact.en: Consent can be withdrawn at any point, including halfway through something, and for any reason or none. A yes to one thing, or a yes given yesterday, does not cover anything else. When someone says stop, or their body language shows they are no longer comfortable, the other person must stop straight away.
fact.hg: Consent kisi bhi point par wapas liya ja sakta hai, beech mein bhi, aur kisi bhi reason se ya bina reason ke. Ek cheez ke liye boli 'yes', ya kal boli 'yes', kisi aur cheez par apply nahi hoti. Jab koi 'stop' bole, ya unki body language dikhaye ki woh ab comfortable nahi hain, toh saamne wale ko turant ruk jaana chahiye.

why.en: People worry that changing their mind is 'leading someone on' or unfair, and some believe an agreement must be completed like a promise.
why.hg: Logon ko darr rehta hai ki mann badalna saamne wale ko 'lead on' karna ya unfair hai, aur kuch log maante hain ki haami ko promise ki tarah poora karna hi padta hai.

claim.en: Most people who sexually abuse children are someone the child already knows.
claim.hg: Bachchon ka sexual abuse karne wale zyadatar log woh hote hain jinhe bachcha pehle se jaanta hai.

fact.en: This is true, and it surprises many people. Child protection work in India and around the world consistently finds that the person is usually a relative, neighbour, family friend, teacher or someone else the child knows and trusts, not a stranger. That is why 'stranger danger' alone is not enough, and why children need to know they can tell about anyone.
fact.hg: Yeh sach hai, aur bahut logon ko surprise karta hai. India aur duniya bhar mein child protection ke kaam mein baar-baar yahi saamne aata hai ki aisa karne wala usually koi relative, padosi, family friend, teacher ya koi aur hota hai jise bachcha jaanta hai aur jis par trust karta hai, koi stranger nahi. Isiliye sirf 'stranger danger' sikhana kaafi nahi hai, aur isiliye bachchon ko pata hona chahiye ki woh kisi ke bhi baare mein bata sakte hain.

why.en: Warnings at home and in films focus on strangers, and it is painful to imagine that a trusted or respected person could harm a child.
why.hg: Ghar ki warnings aur films strangers par hi focus karti hain, aur yeh sochna painful hai ki koi trusted ya respected insaan bachche ko harm kar sakta hai.

claim.en: After marriage, a spouse's consent is automatic.
claim.hg: Shaadi ke baad spouse ka consent automatic hota hai.

fact.en: Marriage is a commitment, not a permanent yes. Each spouse can refuse any sexual act at any time, and forced sex in marriage is sexual violence that harms physical and mental health. The BNS has a contested exception for husbands whose wives are 18 or over; it never applies if the wife is under 18. That is a legal gap, not proof that consent is unnecessary. Wives can also use the domestic violence law and the 181 helpline.
fact.hg: Shaadi ek commitment hai, permanent 'yes' nahi. Har spouse ke paas kisi bhi sexual act se, kisi bhi time, mana karne ka right rehta hai, aur shaadi mein forced sex sexual violence hai jo physical aur mental health ko nuksaan pahunchata hai. BNS mein 18 ya usse zyada umar ki wife ke case mein husband ke liye ek contested exception hai; wife 18 se kam ho toh yeh kabhi apply nahi hota. Yeh law ka gap hai, is baat ka proof nahi ki consent zaroori nahi. Wives domestic violence law aur 181 helpline ki help bhi le sakti hain.

why.en: Traditional ideas describe sex as a marital 'duty', and the legal exception makes many people assume that the law itself approves.
why.hg: Traditional soch sex ko shaadi ki 'duty' batati hai, aur legal exception ki wajah se bahut log maan lete hain ki law isse approve karta hai.
